decisions.evidence: R1 maker (round 1, role maker): scope lists 'Explicit exclusions such as ... automatic metadata retrieval'. R1 client (round 1, role client) pt.1: 'When I paste in a link, I expect the app to go grab the page's title, a short description, the little site icon, and ideally a preview picture on its own ... I saw the spec specifically says that's out of scope — that won't work for me.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker explicitly excluded automatic metadata retrieval, contradicting REF-BM-02 (auto-collect title/description/favicon/preview). Divergence established from the presented exclusion independent of response. Client rejects the contradicting exclusion outright, so negate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope (add/edit/open/delete, tags, search, sort) contains no unread/read-later concept. R1 client pt.2: 'A "read it later" pile ... mark a bookmark as unread, see just my unread ones on their own, and then mark it read so it drops off that list.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Read-later/unread queue (REF-BM-17), separate unread view (REF-BM-18), mark-read removal (REF-BM-19) absent from presented scope. Client requests the missing reference requirement, so extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope offers only 'permanently delete bookmarks' as removal. R1 client pt.3: 'the only way to get something out of my main list is to permanently delete it. I'd want a way to tuck a bookmark away — hide it from my normal list and searches but keep it — and be able to look at those set-aside ones separately and bring them back. Delete-for-good should be the separate, final option.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Reversible archive (REF-BM-26), archive-vs-delete distinction (REF-BM-27), separate archived list (REF-BM-28) absent. Client requests missing requirement and states the delete/archive distinction, so extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope lists generic 'Search, filtering, and sorting' only. R1 client pt.4: 'Plain word search is good, but I'd also expect to search by a tag directly, to search an exact phrase in quotes, and to combine things (this tag but not that one, this or that).'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Tag search #tag (REF-BM-14), boolean AND/OR/NOT + groups (REF-BM-15), quoted-phrase exact match (REF-BM-16) absent from presented plain search. Client requests the missing search capabilities, so extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope has tags but no autocomplete-on-entry. R1 client pt.4 tail: 'when I'm typing a tag onto a bookmark, I'd like it to suggest tags I already use.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Existing-tag autocomplete on entry (REF-BM-10) absent. Client requests missing requirement, so extend. Distinct from search capabilities.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope has 'descriptions' but no longer notes. R1 client pt.5: 'Beyond a short description, I'd like to jot my own longer notes on a bookmark and have them show nicely when I look at it. And my search should look inside those notes too.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Markdown/longer notes rendered on view (REF-BM-23) absent; also extends full-text search to notes (REF-BM-12). Client requests the missing requirement, so extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope has no bulk operations. R1 client pt.6: 'When I've got a lot selected — or everything matching what I'm currently looking at — I'd want to tag them, mark them read, set them aside, or delete them all in one go.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Multi-select bulk action (REF-BM-20) and apply-to-whole-filtered-collection (REF-BM-21) absent. Client requests missing requirement, so extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope has no saved filter/bundle. R1 client pt.7: 'If I've got a search-plus-tags combination I keep coming back to, I'd like to save that as its own named view to jump to later.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Saved bundle of search term + included/excluded tags (REF-BM-29) absent. Client requests missing requirement, so extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope: 'Explicit exclusions such as ... import/export'. R1 client closing: 'A couple of these (like import/export) I'm honestly fine leaving out for now, so I won't push on those.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker excluded Netscape import (REF-BM-30) and export (REF-BM-31), diverging from reference (extended). Client explicitly identifies the excluded item and accepts the departure without requesting alignment — accepted_divergence, catch_type=none. Not a bare approval: names the specific excluded capability.

decisions.evidence: Snapshot preservation never presented in-scope. R2 client (round 2, role client) closing: 'down the road I might want the app to keep its own saved copy of a page in case the original ever disappears. I don't need it now, so don't add it; I just want to flag it.' R3 maker (round 3): 'Full-page snapshots explicitly deferred; only bounded preview-image caching is planned.' R3 client: 'you've flagged the "keep its own copy of a page" idea as set aside for later ... that's exactly right, that's what I asked.'
decisions.note: Single decision spanning specification/implementation-plan gates. Local HTML snapshot (REF-BM-24) omitted, diverging from reference (extended). Client explicitly states the expected behaviour (app keeps own saved page copy) and accepts its deferral — accepted_divergence, catch_type=none. R3 is the linked disposition of the same requirement, not a separate opportunity (not double-counted).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Add, edit, open, and permanently delete bookmarks'. R1 client: 'Saving a link, editing it ... that's all the right idea.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Presented core CRUD/open conforms to REF-BM-01 (save by url), 04 (edit), 05 (delete), 08 (open original). Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'URL validation, normalization, and duplicate detection'. R5 client (round 5) verified: 'When I tried to save that same link again — even typed differently — it caught it and told me it's already saved and pointed me to the existing one, instead of making a duplicate.'
decisions.note: Specification/implementation-review. Duplicate detection converging to the existing bookmark conforms to REF-BM-06. Recorded conforming decision; verification is behavioural report, no divergence.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Titles, descriptions, tags, and collections; Search, filtering, and sorting'. R1 client: 'tags, search, filtering, sorting ... that's all the right idea.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. List display (REF-BM-07), tagging (REF-BM-09), tag filter (REF-BM-11), basic full-text search over title/description/url (REF-BM-12/13), sorting (REF-BM-22) presented and conform. Recorded conforming decisions.
